chapter.heading: For the choir director: A psalm of David, to be accompanied by stringed instruments.
Psalm 4
chapter.v:
Answer me
when I call to you, O God who declares me innocent.Free me from my troubles.Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

How long
will you people ruin my reputation? How long will you make groundless accusations? How long will you continue your lies? Interlude

You can
be sure of this: The Lord set apart the godly for himself.The Lord will answer when I call to him.

Don’t sin
by letting anger control you.Think about it overnight and remain silent. Interlude

Offer sacrifices
in the right spirit,and trust the Lord.

Many people
say, “Who will show us better times?”Let your face smile on us, Lord.

You have
given me greater joythan those who have abundant harvests of grain and new wine.

In peace
I will lie down and sleep,for you alone, O Lord, will keep me safe.
